detailed_description: UUID Validator checks one or more pasted UUID strings in the browser. Paste UUIDs one per line, click Validate, and the tool reports how many entries are valid or invalid. Valid entries show the detected version from v1 to v5 and the RFC 4122 variant; invalid entries are marked as invalid format. The validator accepts standard dashed UUIDs and 32-character hexadecimal UUIDs without dashes. It does not decode timestamps or MAC addresses, verify namespace hashes, detect collisions, highlight characters in real time, or export validation metadata.
usage_steps: Paste one UUID or multiple UUIDs, one per line, into the textarea.
Click Validate to check the current input.
Review the valid and invalid counts.
For valid entries, read the detected UUID version and RFC 4122 variant label.
Use Clear to reset the input and validation results.
usage_examples: Paste a list of API IDs to quickly find entries with invalid UUID formatting.
Check whether a copied identifier is a v4 UUID.
Validate 32-character UUID strings copied from logs without dashes.
Separate valid and invalid values before adding sample IDs to a test fixture.
